description: The free, MIT-licensed NetForge Community edition. Installs the `netforge` template: scaffolds an ASP.NET Core 10 + React 19 app with auth, RBAC, the platform layer, theming, and i18n — a polished line-of-business starting point. Pro adds webhooks, audit, dashboard, multi-tenancy, notifications, and more (github.com/sponsors/emonney).
title: NetForge — ASP.NET Core 10 + React 19 starter (MIT)
